journal_lines: §lSkeleton§l on the ridge. §oHeard the bow creak before I saw it.§o Arrow in the dirt.
Felled it before the second shot. Kept moving.
§cTook one in the flank. §oFelt the fletching drag.§o Still cleared it.
Rattling in the dark. Dealt with the rattle.
Closed the distance before it could nock again. Works every time.
Three arrows in the wall behind me. None in me. Fine margin.
Bones scatter when they fall. Messier than expected, quieter than I thought.
§oIt tracked me through the smoke without eyes.§o Doesn't have eyes, exactly. Still found me.
Two of them in a passage. Took the nearer one first. Then the far one.
Heard it before I smelled it. Smelled nothing. Old bones don't smell like much.
Ran the gap between shots. Got my teeth in before it drew again.
§lSkeleton§l standing in the open. Too still for something with no reason to rest.
